desc: Define the diagonal direction vectors and clockwise successor mapping.
Design the iterative DP state and recurrence for straight continuation and the single clockwise turn.
Establish traversal orders that ensure each forward neighbor’s DP value is already computed.
Implement `Solution.lenOfVDiagonal` with \(O(nm)\) time and \(O(nm)\) auxiliary space.
Verify against all examples, length-one paths, straight-only paths, immediate turns, and boundary cases.
